entries.title: Psalms 124:1
segments: <<A Song of Ascents; of David.>> If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, Let Israel now say,

entries.title: Psalms 124:2
segments: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, When men rose up against us;

entries.title: Psalms 124:3
segments: Then they had swallowed us up alive, When their wrath was kindled against us;

entries.title: Psalms 124:4
segments: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, The stream had gone over our soul;

entries.title: Psalms 124:5
segments: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

entries.title: Psalms 124:6
segments: Blessed be Jehovah, Who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

entries.title: Psalms 124:7
segments: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: The snare is broken, and we are escaped.

entries.title: Psalms 124:8
segments: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
